sources.lights: Directional lights (direction of travel, world frame, z up; diffuse and specular linear RGB in [0, 1]) that replace the scene's own three spot lights and the export sun, so level ground is as bright at the horizon as at the tee. Retuned 2026-11-21 on stills of the four grid views at the impact frame of a driver swing (1280x720 tiles; clipped = any channel >= 250; spread = 95th minus 5th percentile of luminance, 0-255). Key: four shadow-casting copies, 0.44 in total, 52 degrees above the horizon and within 0.5 degrees of their mean. At the earlier 40 degrees the cast shadow was 1.2 body heights long and the copies, up to 1.6 degrees from their mean, drew stepped duplicates at its far end in the overhead view; at 52 degrees it is 0.8 body heights, and a 0.6 degree square still grades the edge (1.2 degrees stepped again, one light gave a hard edge). The warm fill beside the key is gone: it added to the key without a shadow and flattened the body. The cool rim from behind the trail side (0.30 in blue) and the low front light (0.23) shape the side away from the key; the front light carries the chest, face and hands that the higher key reaches less. Key specular is 0.04 in total and rim and front 0.05: at 0.12 and 0.1 the forearm and knuckle highlights clipped 2 % of arm skin face-on. Measured before -> after, white shirt: clipped shirt 23.5 % -> 0 % face-on, 24.7 % -> 0 % down-the-line, 51.8 % -> 0 % overhead; shirt spread 78 -> 88 face-on and 43 -> 80 overhead; clipped arm skin 61.8 % -> 0 % face-on and 82.8 % -> 0 % overhead, median arm skin 224 -> 171 (studio scene: 218). A dark saturated shirt gains little: its spread stays near 15-17 of 255, because its base colour is applied twice (material colour times a texture of the same colour), which no light corrects.
sources.headlight: Camera headlight. Ambient 0.38 (was 0.63) and diffuse 0.11 (was 0.15): with ambient at 0.63 the lights could add at most 0.4 before a white shirt clipped, so the body was flat; the key total is now above the ambient term (0.44 against 0.38). The brightest any surface can be lit (ambient plus headlight plus every light it faces) fell from 1.36 to 1.07, which is what removed the clipping. Diffuse 0.11 rather than less keeps the turf of the overhead view within 9 % of its earlier brightness. Specular is the studio value of the scene.
sources.shadow: shadowsize is the shadow map edge in texels (power of two). extent_m is the model extent MuJoCo scales the shadow map and clip planes by, and shadowclip the half width of a directional light's map in extents: 1.0 x 3 m keeps the whole swing inside the map at about 0.4 mm per texel, where the smaller map drew saw-tooth shadow edges on skin.
sources.ground: texture_gain multiplies the two checker colours of the ground texture (clipped to 1). 1.94 (was 1.6) makes up for the lower light on level ground (0.93 against 1.21): median turf luminance 97 -> 92 face-on and 114 -> 104 overhead. It is the largest gain that does not clip the lighter square's green, so the rest of the difference is accepted. checker_contrast is the share of the difference between the two checker colours that is kept (0.35: the squares stay readable as a ground cue without flicker in motion). reflectance 0 stops the turf mirroring the shoes.
